title: Schedule of Inspection Validity by Vehicle Age for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
For **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreements, the age of the registered vehicle bears on the inspection validity days: the calendar days, from the inspection date, for which a passed vehicle inspection counts as the vehicle inspection on file.

**Vehicle age rule.** For a vehicle at least 5 years old, counted as the current calendar year minus its model year, the inspection validity days change by -30 days; for one at least 3 but fewer than 5 years old, they change by -15 days; for one fewer than 3 years old, they do not change.

| Vehicle age (current calendar year less model year) | Change to the inspection validity days |
|---|---|
| 5 years or more | -30 |
| 3 or 4 years | -15 |
| 0, 1 or 2 years | 0 |

**Notes.**
1. The model year is the registered vehicle's model year on the agreement.
2. Age is a whole number of years taken from calendar years alone.

**Hypothetical readings (current calendar year 2026).** Model year 2021: 5 years, -30. Model year 2022: 4 years, -15. Model year 2023: 3 years, -15. Model year 2024: 2 years, no change.
